arguments: the text after the skill name, or the request in the conversation
parallel_reads: make one `read` call for each file, all in the same message
start_search_agent: start the `scout` subagent with the `subagent` tool
start_subagents: start one `delegate` subagent for each with the `subagent` tool, in parallel
delegate: Give this job to a background `researcher` subagent with the `subagent` tool, so that you keep working while it reads.
load_skill: read the `SKILL.md` of the `{0}` skill from the skill list
skill_dir_note: `<skill-dir>` is the base directory of this skill. The skill block gives it when the skill loads.
global_instructions: Store temporary files that do not belong in the project under `/tmp/pi/`. Do not make another top-level directory under `/tmp/`. Ask the user before you change a file outside the active project or `/tmp/pi/`, including with a shell command.
